speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To understand the severity of your condition, are you currently in the first, second, or third trimester, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The specific detail of consuming unpasteurized dairy (ice cream) 3 days prior to sudden onset of fever and headache in a 30-week pregnant patient is highly indicative of Listeria. Given the severity of this infection for the fetus, please confirm if you have received any medical imaging yet. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Pelvic_Ultrasound.
